reason: Omits the independent duplicate mapping paidUserAssistantAddonName in assistantUpsellConfig.ts; the helper is not the sole plan-to-addon source.
Fallback base config's ClientCAs hold only HostCA; UserCA-signed client certificates still fail verification, so returning nil,nil doesn't secure handshake success.

Below-placement holds only for upper-half triggers; aboveLeftOf positions lower-half menus above. Doubt: claim restates the requirement verbatim.
Wrong package/identifier: ftypes defines DotNetCore = dotnet-core; dotnet-deps is analyzer.TypeDotNetDeps, not an ftypes DotNetDeps constant.
Sync local-LRU locking works only within one process; forked workers have separate caches. Doubt: the test itself likely runs single-process.
Not the only consumer: the reduced counts.controversial in userData.counts is also serialized by /api/self and exposed in the API schema.
Mongo's old sum used one countDocuments query; delegating to sortedSetsCard makes per-key calls and breaks scalar input, so behavior isn't preserved.
Enum and duration conversions are right, but the flow omits the json/mapstructure tag mismatch (allowedOrigins vs allowed_origins), dropping fields.
Misstates Go's check: readonly mode needs only the required checksums present; extra entries or vendoring work, so a byte-exact gold go.sum isn't required.
Global registration isn't required; names can be passed to template.render as kwargs, so the necessity conclusion misstates the requirement.
Off-by-one boundary: the issue requires accepting payloads up to 2D, so exactly 96,000,000 must be accepted; errors start above it.
With buffer capacity, select may pick the send case after cancellation; the closed-emitter error is returned only when its case wins.
Treats QTabBar stylesheet as effective despite custom TabBarStyle, which Qt says stylesheets don't support. Doubt: a doc warning alone doesn't show conflict.
Omits the assert(body) checks in the best/controversial tests and body-field assertions in other controller tests; they don't check only status.
In BASE with both flags, messages[0] is live stdout and the test passes. Doubt: agent likely meant the new live-stderr behavior.
At this commit retrieval just loads stored playlist_tracks rows; smart-playlist rules are not evaluated or their results persisted.
Returns 0 only for unparseable or non-finite text; malformed '1dB2' becomes 12 and invalid R128 like '1.5' or '32768' give nonzero gains.
Neither get_non_isbn_asin nor is_asin_only exists at the pinned commit; the issue introduces them as new interfaces.
Service.Enabled() is true for an unset flag, so with no proxy kubernetes block !fc.Proxy.Kube.Enabled() is false and no warning fires.
Narrows the label requirement to htmlFor, omitting the label element. Doubt: context shows agent meant className/text are unconstrained, which is accurate.
BASE CorsConfig has no AllowedHeaders field. Doubt: agent had already added it; the test diff truly showed expected AllowedHeaders nil.
mapstructure copies time.Duration into the map unconverted; the hook only converts string to duration. Doubt: verifier concedes a separate conversion works.
Assignment is guarded by fc.Kube.Enabled(); nil configs return early and explicit 'enabled: no' skips it, so not for any config.
The Blink setting names are the dark-mode keys passed via the dark-mode-settings switch; the either/or classification is wrong.
FieldByName matches exact names; reflection reads fields only when the model uses a listed candidate, not regardless of naming.
getCategoryFields(null) returns an object with defaulted minTags/maxTags in Redis/Mongo, not undefined; Postgres would throw rather than skip checks.
With highlights supplied, non-formatted returnString returns highlighted safeBody; strippedBody is returned only when no highlights are given.
Capture-phase onKeyUpCapture fires before the target's onKeyUp onClick, so closing happens first, the reverse of the claimed order.
Method exists, but its first parameter is pkgID populating PkgID, not filePath; the claim misstates the argument's meaning.
Recalled doc for EnrollDeviceInit in native/api.go, which doesn't exist in baseline; the issue's macOS-only note belongs to RunCeremony.
touchid's export_test.go exposes a test-only exported hook used by the external test package; a non-test exported hook isn't required.
Omits the production NewForwarder constructor and its NewTLSServer call; direct Forwarder construction isn't limited to the kube test.
Issue requires shebang-less modules to run with a default interpreter; returning None makes the action plugin raise instead.
Presence holds only if the collector returns non-nil; a nil, nil result leaves DeviceData nil. Doubt: that counterexample is contrived.
The casing rule covers vCardFileToVCards strings, the lowercase KIND rule covers mapped contacts; no contradiction exists.
validateTags only uniqs tags; cleanup of empty entries happens later in createTags/updateTopicTags, so empty tags can reach validation.
Fallback runs only when pagination is enabled; with usePagination false the helper returns 0 without calling sortedSetsCardSum.
Requirements mandate go.mod edits, an exception to a blanket ban. Doubt: agent's instructions do say not to modify configuration files.
